title: 29 By ANT
description: This dataset comprises neuroimaging recordings from participants undergoing laser pain stimulation with concurrent pain rating assessments. This is a NEMAR-hosted reorganization of OpenNeuro dataset ds005285. Participants received 160 laser stimulations of varying intensities across 4 blocks, with pain ratings collected on a 0-10 scale. The study investigates pain perception and modulation mechanisms, with potential applications to understanding pain processing and therapeutic interventions.
methods_description: Participants underwent laser stimulation at calibrated intensities (corresponding to pain ratings of 4 and 7 on a 0-10 scale) delivered approximately every 20 seconds in blocks of 40 trials (80 high-intensity and 80 low-intensity stimulations across 4 blocks). Pain ratings were collected via computer interface within a 5-second window following each stimulus. Inter-trial intervals were randomized between 1-3 seconds after rating completion.
